entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: Version of Jace who cut away the parts of himself that objected to his plan and seeks to merge two Multiverses.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whose mind was cut apart; his remnants hold his best pieces and the Eye of Jace watches cadets.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Planeswalker who growled that they swore to keep watch and was tormented by the memory trap.

entities.name: Jazal
entities.description: Ajani's brother, whose voice tormented him inside his head.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: Oracle of Arcavios whose mind Jace followed.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: Student who called upon a being to fix what Jace had done and received Jace's spark.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: Name Jace gives to the being who asks whether she is a person.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who believed Tam; a version of her had never known pain.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Planeswalker who looked at the young boy from Vryn and spoke to Vraska.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Necromancer planeswalker, with a twin double.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Planeswalker whose home was lost long ago.

entities.name: Kwia Vigorbloom
entities.description: Vigorbloom battlemage who nurtures and grafts.

entities.name: Loot, the Anomaly
entities.description: Being whose value is absolute in any Multiverse; Jace kept him locked away.

entities.name: Danitha
entities.description: Benalian who pledges her blade to hope.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Planeswalker formerly Kytheon Iora, hero of the people.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Survivor who swears peaceful rest in Sigarda's name.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel in whose name Thalia swears.

entities.name: Yoshimaru
entities.description: Companion of the Emperor and leader of Towashi's dogs.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Emperor who rules with truth, respect and passion.

entities.name: Fblthp
entities.description: Lost homunculus who loves to travel.

entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: Usurper of Kefnet who thanks Rhonas.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: Glutton of Urborg and goliath of Otaria.

entities.name: Yar-Kul
entities.description: Refined-palate man who trespassed in Krosan forest.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Valley animalfolk who turned to Calamity Beasts to bring down King Glarb.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: Mage who made diamondstorm power his own.

entities.name: Pia
entities.description: Rebuilder who hopes to break the Consulate's hold on Chandra and Kiran.

entities.name: Titanbones
entities.description: Giant who finds gifts in little things.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The school and tower of Jace's making, with five annexes.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane whose oracle returns to the source of the world.

entities.name: Echoverse Fulcrum
entities.description: Tower transformed to merge the old Multiverse with the new.

entities.name: Eye of Jace
entities.description: Eye worn by cadets that follows their moves.

entities.name: Memory trap
entities.description: Trap made from the Theorist's memories.

events.summary: The Theorist used his memories to trap parts of Jace and friends opposing his plan.
events.quote: The Theorist used his own memories to trap the parts of Jace that objected to his plans

events.summary: Jace followed Jadzi's mind to witness two planes becoming one.
events.quote: Jace followed Jadzi's mind to witness two planes becoming one.

events.summary: In the Meditation Realm Jace saw a complete Multiverse and resolved to make it real.
events.quote: In the Meditation Realm, Jace had seen himself reflected in a Multiverse complete in every detail.

events.summary: Jace names the newly awakened being Tamira.
Chandra's doppelganger distracts at the Theorist's order.
Every part of Jace's mind that objected to his plan was cut away, leaving the Theorist.
events.quote: Every part of Jace's mind that objected to his plan had been cut away.

events.summary: Jace believed merging the two Multiverses would end suffering.
events.quote: Jace believed that if he could successfully merge the two Multiverses, he would remove the suffering of so many.

events.summary: Liliana ordered a swarm of rats against her twin.
events.quote: as she ordered the swarm against her sickeningly nice twin

events.summary: Jazal's voice in Ajani's head forces a choice between vengeance and friends.
events.quote: Your vengeance, or your friends. What will it be?

events.summary: Tam called upon the one being who could fix what Jace had done.
events.quote: Her choice made, Tam called upon the one being who could fix what Jace had done.

events.summary: Garruk comforts the young boy from Vryn.
events.quote: Garruk looked at the young, scared boy from Vryn.

events.summary: Tam offered to help and Vraska believed her.
events.quote: Tam had offered to help and Vraska believed her.

events.summary: One Liliana tells the other Josu's ashes choke her.
events.quote: Josu's ashes choke you even now.

events.summary: The team believed what was left of Jace could still be reasoned with.
events.quote: the team believed what was left of Jace could still be reasoned with

events.summary: Jace entrusts his spark to Tam.
events.quote: A spark is power and freedom. Use it better than I did

events.summary: The tower transformed into the Echoverse Fulcrum to merge the Multiverses.
events.quote: The tower transformed to fulfill its true purpose

events.summary: Mabel turned to Calamity Beasts to bring down King Glarb after her village was destroyed.
events.quote: With her village destroyed, Mabel turned to the Calamity Beasts to bring down King Glarb.

events.summary: Jace kept Loot locked away and hidden.
events.quote: so Jace kept him locked away and hidden

relations.note: The Theorist is what remained of Jace after his objecting parts were cut away.
relations.quote: The Theorist was all that remained.
I merely chose to apply it in usurping him.

relations.note: Yuriko is loyal to Emperor Tamiyo.
relations.quote: She has more than earned my loyalty.
I traveled with Mowu as a Planeswalker.

relations.note: Vraska believed Tam's offer to help.
relations.quote: Tam had offered to help and Vraska believed her.
Karn forged the empty world of Mirrodin
